mintAuthority.summary: USDQ is minted when users borrow against overcollateralized CDPs (wETH/wstETH/weETH/SCR) in Quill's Liquity-v2/BOLD fork on Scroll; minting is restricted to registered branch contracts. The USDQ token and QuillAccessManager are UUPS proxies. ADMIN_ROLE of the AccessManager is held by a Gnosis Safe 1.4.1 (0x32fd58b8, 3-of-6, has a guard at 0x075233a1), making the system mutable but multisig-gated.

controls.label: Liquity-v2 BoldToken branch minters (BorrowerOperations/ActivePool/StabilityPool)
controls.capDescription: Branch minting is restricted to registered BorrowerOperations/ActivePool-style contracts with collateral-registry caps that Quill admin controls can update.
controls.evidence: At Scroll block 34053392: USDQ token (0xdb9e8f82d6d45fff803161f2a5f75543972b229a) is a UUPS proxy with implementation at 0x4103155fb2dcf8b6138c8eb4be0542facc9a7523 (code length 20084). No external proxy admin slot populated. Branch minting is restricted to registered BorrowerOperations/ActivePool-style contracts with collateral-registry caps.

controls.label: QuillAccessManager (UUPS proxy, admin = Quill Safe multisig)
controls.evidence: At Scroll block 34053392: AccessManager (0xBe589551) is a UUPS proxy (impl=0x3e5462da8e6c3971d445d717c389a8bec036b719, 'QuillAccessManagerUpgradeable'). ADMIN_ROLE (id=0) was granted to Safe 0x32fd58b8 at deployment (block 15218053); deployer revoked its own role at block 15218072 per on-chain transaction history.

controls.label: Quill admin Safe multisig (holds ADMIN_ROLE in AccessManager)
controls.evidence: At Scroll block 34053392: getOwners() returned 6 addresses, slot3=6 (ownerCount), slot4=3 (threshold). masterCopy at slot0=0x29fcb43b46531bca003ddc8fcb67ffe91900c762 (VERSION=1.4.1). getModules() returned empty array. Guard storage slot=0x075233a13896b064f19eb3cdeaa2fb03e3457726 (contract with 2640-byte code). Fallback handler=0xfd0732dc9e303f09fcef3a7388ad10a83459ec99. The deployer EOA (0x9b8d3e60) is owner 6 but is not the sole ADMIN_ROLE holder in the AccessManager.

review.evidence: On-chain reads at Scroll block 34053392: USDQ token (0xdb9e8f82) is a UUPS proxy (implementation=0x4103155fb2dcf8b6138c8eb4be0542facc9a7523, no external proxy admin). QuillAccessManager proxy (0xBe589551) is also a UUPS proxy (impl=0x3e5462da8e6c3971d445d717c389a8bec036b719, 'QuillAccessManagerUpgradeable' per Scrollscan). ADMIN_ROLE (id=0) was granted via grantRole tx at Scroll block 15218053 to 0x32fd58b8c4d454ab585dea736b7d2b5929b6676c (the deployer revoked its own ADMIN_ROLE at block 15218072). The ADMIN is a Gnosis Safe 1.4.1 multisig (0x32fd58b8, 3-of-6, no modules, HAS a guard at 0x075233a1, fallback handler=0xfd0732dc). Owner 4 is the deployer EOA (0x9b8d3e60) who retains a Safe signer seat.
